name: AP2112K-3.3TRG1
title: 600 mA CMOS low-dropout regulator with enable
summary: The AP2112 is a CMOS linear regulator with fixed outputs of 1.2, 1.8, 2.5, 2.6 or 3.3 V, guaranteed for 600 mA of load from a 2.5 V to 6 V supply. The output holds within ±1.5 %; the 3.3 V version drops 250 mV typical at 600 mA. It draws 55 µA with no load and 0.01 µA when disabled, discharges its output through 60 Ω while off, folds its current back to 50 mA into a short, shuts down on overtemperature, and is stable with a 1 µF output capacitor. Packages are SOT25, SOT89-5 and SO-8.

circuits.title: Typical application
circuits.description: The regulator needs only two parts round it: 1 µF from VIN to ground at the input and 1 µF from VOUT to ground at the output. EN is the on/off control, high for on and low for off. The same circuit serves every output voltage, 1.2 V, 1.8 V, 2.5 V, 2.6 V or 3.3 V.

parts.note: X7R or X5R when a 1.0 µF ceramic is used
X7R or X5R when a 1.0 µF ceramic is used

operation.text: Five fixed outputs: 1.2 V, 1.8 V, 2.5 V, 2.6 V and 3.3 V, each in SOT25, SO-8 and SOT89-5. SOT89-5 comes with two pinouts that swap EN and NC: R5 has EN on pin 3, R5A has EN on pin 1. SOT25, SOT89-5 and SO-8 were earlier called SOT-23-5, SOT-89-5 and SOIC-8.
At least 600 mA of continuous load current, output accuracy ±1.5 %, and a fast loop response to line and load transients.

EN above 1.5 V turns the regulator on; below 0.4 V turns it off. A 3 MΩ resistor inside holds EN low when it is left undriven. While off, the part draws 0.01 µA typical and a 60 Ω path inside connects VOUT to GND, emptying the output capacitor. With no load the output comes up in about 20 µs.

Past its maximum the output current folds back: with VOUT shorted to ground it falls to about 50 mA. A current load already present at the output when the part is enabled can hold it in foldback so it does not start; systems with several supplies or with negative supplies, and tests that apply a current source before enable, are the cases this concerns. A normal load, a load line through the origin, does not interfere with the foldback limit.
The output turns off when the junction reaches about +160 °C and turns on again after it has cooled by about 25 °C.
The loop is stable with a 1.0 µF output capacitor of ceramic, tantalum or aluminium electrolytic type. When 1.0 µF ceramics are chosen for input and output, they should be X7R or X5R.
Production test is at TA = +25 °C; figures over temperature are guaranteed by design.
Operating ambient range -40 °C to +85 °C. ESD 400 V machine model, 4000 V human body model. Lead-free, RoHS compliant, halogen and antimony free.
